commitResults.messageTitle: feat: Rename Duke chatbot to Friedberg
commitResults.messageBody:
For level-0 of the iP, we need to rename the Duke.java into my chatbot
of Friedberg.java

commitResults.messageTitle: feat ref: Refactor chatbot functions and add echo
commitResults.messageBody:
Previously, all functionality was in the main function. Refactored the
greet into its own function and implemented the echo function to echo
whatever the user inputs.

commitResults.messageTitle: feat: Add list
commitResults.messageBody:
Implemented the functionality to store userInput and then list them
back to the user. Also refactored the userInput to be checked against
preset commands

commitResults.messageTitle: chore: Make adding to list print added: item
commitResults.messageBody:
Previously, adding an item to the list just echos the item without the
added: prefix.

commitResults.messageTitle: feat: Abstract tasks into a Class
commitResults.messageBody:
Previously, items/tasks were just a String object. Now it has been
abstracted into a class, making sure all the previous functionality
still worked

commitResults.messageTitle: nit: Abstract running the chatbot into a single function
commitResults.messageBody:
Previously, main function determined the logic of running the chatbot.
This has been moved into its own .run() function.

commitResults.messageTitle: feat: Add marking and unmarking tasks
commitResults.messageBody:
Implemented marking and unmarking tasks for the Task class.
Then implemented the ability for the chatbot to read more commands to
mark and unmark tasks

commitResults.messageTitle: feat: Adds Todo, Event and Deadline
commitResults.messageBody:
Previously we only had tasks, create Todo Event and Deadline tasks.
They all have their own rendering and inputs

commitResults.messageTitle: feat: Add FriedbergExceptions classes and handle exceptions
commitResults.messageBody:
Previously, the errors and exceptions were manually handled.
Now with FriedbergExceptions, we can use java's Exception handling to
handle and print out user errors.

commitResults.messageTitle: chore: Wrap command with a try block to catch unknown exceptions
commitResults.messageBody:
Previously, any other unchecked exceptions would just crash the program.
Now with the catch block they can be dealt with gracefully to the user.

commitResults.messageTitle: chore: Migrate to using ArrayList<Task>
commitResults.messageBody:
Previously we were using a static 100 length List, now with an ArrayList
we can dynamically add and track tasks. This is to alow prepare for
Level-6

commitResults.messageTitle: feat: Add delete command to Friedberg
commitResults.messageBody: This is for Level-6

commitResults.messageTitle: ref: Refactor TaskStatus to use an Enum
commitResults.messageBody:
This is because the TaskStatus could be multiple different statuses, so
it should be represented as a Enum in java.

commitResults.messageTitle: chore: Move tasks and relevant classes into their own folder
commitResults.messageBody:
Before we just had the Todo, Deadline, Event and Task classes in their
own files in the root directory. Cleaning them up into their own task
folder.

This is in preparation for the refactor to implement file I/O to them
later on in this level

commitResults.messageTitle: WIP: Add basic DataHandler as well as project wide constants
commitResults.messageBody:
This is setting up for Level-7 where we want to be able to serialize and
deserialize the task data. We need a DataHandler and this just scafolds
the DataHandler class as well as the necessary initalization code.

commitResults.messageTitle: WIP: Implement Level-7 halfway
commitResults.messageBody: Just to sync to github

commitResults.messageTitle: WIP: Shift TaskStatus enum into its own class
commitResults.messageBody: To sync to github for Level-7

commitResults.messageTitle: feat: Add Tasks saving to file system
commitResults.messageBody:
Previously, all created tasks were only available as long as the program
was running in memory. Now the tasks and their information is stored to
disk so the next time the chatbot is ran, it will be saved and loaded.

feat: Add Date support for Task
commitResults.messageBody:
Previously the dates required by Event and Deadlines accepted just
strings. This commit adds support for working with Date objects. This
way we can check if the Date is valid and format them. We also shifted
the Constants into its own common package so that all files in the
project can refer to them.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge branch 'Level-10'
feat: Add assertions to critical hot paths
commitResults.messageBody:
Before this increment, no assertions were used in the code. After this
week's lesson, for this increment we will be adding assertions into the
hot paths of the chatbot's code.

This is to ensure more logical and functional bugs are caught in the
development stage where the assertions would fail first. This lets us
have more confidence once we push our code to users to try that it will
work.

commitResults.messageBody:
For this increment, implements 3 new command for the archive feature.
With this you are able to archive tasks without deleting them. The
archived tasks are saved to another file on the file system and you can
view them through the chatbot as well
